notes.title: Goetia, The Turing Test, and Tokyo Dark lead the latest Humble Bundle
notes.content:
Square Enix Collective is a platform that enables game makers to share their ideas with gamers, get feedback, maybe get some crowdfunding support, and possibly even sign a publishing deal. It is also the source of the games in the latest Humble Bundle, which went live today with Goetia, Octahedron, and Deadbeat Heroes for just $1. 

Forking over more than the average price will also net you The Turing Test, Forgotten Anne Collector's Edition, and Black the Fall. Make it at least $12 and Tokyo Dark and Children of Zodiarcs will be yours as well. It may not be the highest-profile bundle in the history of Humble, but it does make for an interesting mix of more offbeat stuff that doesn't often get time in the spotlight. 

The Humble Square Enix Collective supports two fine charities, GamesAid and Make-A-Wish, and will be available until April 30. 

Some online stores give us a small cut if you buy something through one of our links. Read our affiliate policy for more info.

notes.title: SteamOS version available now!
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Today we bring you some more Goetia news, we've been working hard and as promised the SteamOS version of the game is available now! 

The minimum/recommended specs are as follows: 
GC: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
CPU: Intel Core i5 4460
RAM: 8192 MB DIMM DDR3

Now is your time to explore and solve the mysteries of Blackwood Manor. 


- Amy

notes.title: Update 1.2!
notes.content:
Hey all! 

The latest update includes some of the minor and major bug fixes.

Bug fixes
•             Fixed the bug that had the torch (staff + rag) stuck into the tower's floor. 
•             Fixed the bug that got the same torch (or the objects it is made up of) stuck under the tower's floor. 
•             Fixed a bug that allowed the player to take an object through the tower's wall. If the object passed the wall, it will be put back to its original place.
•             Fixed a bug that stopped players from launching a new game (save file problem.)
•             Fixed a collision problem with the top of the well in the village.
•             Objects will no longer get stuck under the room with the glowing pillars.
•             Fixed a bug that prevented players from clicking on the resolution drop-down menu because it was too small

Various additions & corrections
•             On the map, the room you're currently in will glow 
•             Assets are now adapted to lower resolutions
•             Spelling mistakes have been corrected (French and English)


Thanks for playing! 


- Amy

notes.title: Mac launch & Update 1.1 Information
notes.content:
Hi all, 

We hope you're enjoying Goetia - we have a couple of announcements and some information on the bug fixes in 'Update 1.1' below.

Announcements:
•	Mac version is now available!
•	Linux version will be released soon!

 
Update 1.1 Patch notes / bug fixes:
•	Audio feedback has been added in the puzzles involving pieces of paper (in the kitchen and in the cabinet of curiosities), this is to let the player know when the paper is in place.
•	The magnetism of the papers in the kitchen and fireplace puzzle has been extended. It should be easier to validate the puzzle.
•	We have added the possibility to get objects out of alternate realities.
•	It is now impossible to get an object from the manor stuck in the Fields of Stone. If this has happened to you, the object will now be automatically put back in its original place.
•	Fixed the bug that allowed players to simultaneously open multiple text boxes at the end of the Observatory Tower puzzle.
•	Missing kickstarter backers on the marble headstone have been added.
•	Fixed various typographical errors.


Any questions, pop them below and I'll answer them as quickly as possible! 


- Amy

notes.title: Shine A Light On The Past: Goetia Out Now
notes.content:
Goetia [official site] is a point and click adventure game that follows the spirit a deceased teenage girl, risen from the grave and keen to uncover the events that led to the downfall of her family estate. (It’s pronounced go-et-eh-ya and not go-ee-sha.) I had a wee bash at Rezzed and really enjoyed it. And it’s out now, so you can too. Here’s how it looks:

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Goetia has now officially launched!
notes.content:
So it's time, Goetia has how been released into the wild, yay! 

We would like to say thank you for being so supportive on the lead up to the release, and we hope you enjoy our game. 

We'd love to hear your feedback so please feel free to leave us comments, share any screenshots (no spoilers, please) and use the forums to help others solve any puzzles they might be finding a bit tricky. I would definitely recommend having a notepad to hand… 

Thanks for the playing! 



- The entire development team
